caveats: Exploratory tuning on development validation only; independent test untouched.
Grouped CV mitigates but cannot eliminate overfitting or design-selection bias.
RRF candidate selection is simulated within cached 200 documents from top600 retrieval; not an end-to-end retrieval rerun.
Metadata prefilter uses cached per-document first-evidence constraint, not an online pipeline modification.
Only one existing MiniLM model per candidate; 'mini_text' vs 'mini_metadata' is input formatting, not a comparison of different models.
Candidate/pair counts are computational proxies; actual inference latency is not measured.
Changing current production retrieval.py, stage2_retrieval.py, or RAG configuration requires a separate validated integration and real rerun.
